product_category: AI 3D model generation platform (text, image and sketch to textured, rigged, print-ready 3D models, with plugins, API and a studio workspace)
description: A fictional market of 100 B2B buyers for an AI 3D generation platform, across three segments: independent pros and startups (30), SMB game studios (35) and large studios and publishers (35). Buyers are bucketed into eight personas: studio leader, art director, technical lead, production artist, producer, legal/security/procurement, indie business owner, and developer/agent builder. Each company carries the buying committee its segment really has. Pain points come from the Meshy persona doc, the messaging teardown and a review readout of 1,828 Trustpilot and G2 reviews, with intensity that varies by company. All names and companies are invented.
